column2: Before politics she studied chemistry at Oxford and worked as a research chemist, testing emulsifiers for a food company. It's such a pub-quiz staple that plenty of people know it.

In 1916 he dipped his pen into molten tin instead of his inkwell and pulled out a thin metal thread, a single crystal. His method now grows the silicon crystals that almost every computer chip is cut from.
